notes: Scan 024 is a mathematical manuscript on a blank printed Académie d’Aix-Marseille / Inspection académique de Vaucluse letterhead. It is classified text, with the printed block separately inventoried as Print. The dark authorial 6 is distinct from the pale bottom-left 23. No date is written on this sheet.

The full original was viewed once for layout. Exactly two native-resolution overlapping halves were generated and viewed once: top [0,0,1678,1297], bottom [0,1062,1678,2359]. Every physical text/formula row, diagram, deletion and marginal item was then read against C and H. The page is 1678×2359 pixels.

Fifteen first-pass crops were created and actually viewed. p10 clipped upper strokes of the still-undecided b) parenthesis; at the main reviewer’s explicit request p15 replaced it with complete context. No decided place was re-cropped. A p06 tool attempt failed before returning an image; the subsequent successful call supplied the actual view. No OCR, browsing, external research, other-page inspection or TeX compilation was used.

lines_read=39 counts the three printed text rows, the two handwritten foliation rows, the two opening-question rows, individual independent a)/b)/case rows, the two lower annotations and Sigma-label row, the remaining main text/formula rows, and the four slanted margin rows. Rules, cancellation strokes and the marginal arrow are geometry, not additional text lines. Side-by-side continuous prose/formula content is counted once; independent case rows are counted separately.

Scan 024 p02: the orbit term has a flat/angular lower bracket with short upturned ends, unlike the central-cusp braces below the two union factors in p03. The drawing preserves this distinction without turning the letters into paths. The annotation i in Z/3Z and the point in X2*=X2 minus {e2} remains below that bracket.

Scan 024 p03–p04: the entire union is separately underlined. A cancelled sign remains before live Delta prime. The image map has a closely retraced shaft and one rightward head; its full label delta prime=(sigma,id_X2) lies below. The retrace is not assigned the semantics of a different double-arrow relation.

Scan 024 p05: M0878 resolves to parmi les, giving de deux parmi les trois. The first Sigma index in that paragraph is newly doubtful as 1|0 because of its filled, oval retracing; the clean Sigma1 label under the earlier union does not erase this local ambiguity. No final full stop follows the singleton at the end of NB.

Scan 024 p06: the source writes a short right arrow between X2×X2 and the group {Sigma1 union Sigma2), and uses a curly opening delimiter with a round closing delimiter. Both witnesses normalize the arrow to setminus, and H also normalizes the opening delimiter. The arrow is preserved even though the surrounding discussion invites a complement interpretation. The separately written setminus in p02 is a single oblique stroke and provides a useful same-page contrast.

Scan 024 p07–p08: the abbreviation is literally n et s., with a visibly tall crossed t and separated n / et / s groups. It is not expanded in the transcription. The next row explicitly begins l’on after the preceding que. The digit 2 of 2 cas is visible in the native half; p08 clipped its upper tip, so the corresponding second-reading box includes the full row and numeral.

Scan 024 p09: the empty-set notation is kept under phi|varnothing doubt, ranked by the long-stem/small-loop ductus rather than by the known empty-set sense. This adds uncertainty only; it is not logged as a settled correction against either witness.

Scan 024 p11 and p15: both trivialt forms remain doubtful at their condensed ending. H’s full trivialement is not written. No superscript is imposed where the terminal return does not securely show one. The struck y-like prefix in b) is distinct from the following live y. The left-margin note is slanted and its separate arrow points from the b)-side toward the note’s cardinal 2.

Scan 024 p12–p13: an unmatched closing parenthesis appears immediately after live X2* in the quantified phrase; it is retained in addition to the later ). after the first inequality. The next clause starts ou s’il y a. The cancelled point and the struck deux|donc remain unresolved. The final period is present, but no closing square bracket follows it.

The upper six point occurrences have a heavier, more zigzag course and retain C’s xi|zeta ranking. The lower nine have a thinner bent head and long lower stroke and retain zeta|xi. These are local ranked doubts within the same variable family, not an assertion that the argument changes variables. No mathematical expectation silently chooses a glyph.

All 19 supplied marks are addressed in order. Two are resolved (M0878 to the alternative parmi les; M0879 to other, n et s.); seventeen remain open. Six doubts within deleted text are recorded separately. New local doubts concern the first NB Sigma index and the phi-like empty-set sign. Every open formula and all deletions/marginal text are included in the second-reading boxes.

The conditional graph-surjectivity check recorded below was performed directly. It does not repair the written arrow, prove the source’s whole surrounding argument without hypotheses, or determine any point glyph.
